gdprSubtitle: Deletion (anonymization) of the personal data of unenrolled pupils. Restricted to Management.
oblioBanner: Only unenrolled pupils and their parents. Permanent deletion anonymizes personal data (irreversible): audit logs and tax documents (invoices) are kept as required by law.
oblioNonSelezionato: Select a pupil to analyze and anonymize the data.
oblioAvviso: You are about to irreversibly anonymize the data of {nome}.
richiesteBanner: Requests started by parents from the app (Profile and delegates). Fulfilling them anonymizes the parent and their unenrolled children (irreversible); children still enrolled and tax documents remain. To be fulfilled within 30 days (GDPR).
richiesteNonSelezionato: Select a request to fulfill it.
richiesteAvviso: You are about to irreversibly anonymize the account of {nome}.
diarySubtitle: View today's attendance (roll call stays with the teachers) and fill in/update the class diary.
diaryNessunaSezione: No nursery/preschool section in your locations. If that's not what you expected, check that your user profile has an associated location (Directory → Staff).
diaryVuotoPresenti: No attendance recorded today: roll call hasn't been done yet (switch to "All" to see the section anyway).
compitiEmptyAssegnati: You have no pending tasks to do right now.
compitiEmptyCreati: You haven't created any staff tasks recently.
compitiEmptyTutti: No active tasks in your locations.
compitiEmptyArchivio: There are no completed tasks in the archive.
ricevutiIntro: Enrollment requests received from the standard form. Review them and import them into the records.
ricevutiReferente: Contact / account holder (receives the login account)
ricevutiImportNonCompletatoDesc: The request stays among those to import. Fix the indicated data and press «Import into records» again.
ricevutiCredInviate: Credentials sent by email to the contact.
ricevutiCredNonInviate: Email not sent: communicate the credentials manually.
inviabiliIntro: Customizable forms to send to parents via a link. Edit them in the builder and publish them to get the shareable link.
inviabiliStandardDesc: Public wizard, always active. Requests arrive in the «Received forms» tab. Editable from the builder.
inviabiliNessunModulo: No custom forms. Create one with «New form».
inviabiliResetConferma: Reset the standard enrollment form to its default values? Any changes made will be discarded.
inviabiliResetSuccess: Standard enrollment form restored to its default values.
inviabiliStandardSediNota: One link for all locations: the parent chooses the site in the first step of the form.

protCercaPlaceholder: Search by subject, sender, recipient or number…
protTabelleAssenti: The register tables are not present in this database.
protNessunProtocolloFiltri: There are no protocols for the selected filters. Press «Register document» at the top to record the first one.

protUploadHint:

modSubtitle: Queue of reports received from parents and staff. Triage and handling reserved to the Management.
